THE PRODUCT COLLECTION

Five expressions.
One sensory language.

Discover the individual character of every fragrance through form, material, and scent. Each flacon pairs sculptural cap artistry with an antique-gold keepsake charm and an ingredient pouch.

Current Hero

OUR PHILOSOPHY

More than what
you smell.

“Sparsh Gandha explores the meeting point of scent, touch, and sight — translating the character of fragrance into a physical form.”

In traditional perfumery, fragrance is treated as an ephemeral mist — invisible, intangible, and fleeting. Sparsh Gandha asks: What if you could touch the scent before the first mist? What if the weight of the cap, the texture of the raw botanical pouch, and the glint of the antique gold medallion revealed its sacred personality?

THE BRAND MANIFESTO

“From invisible to tangible — where form guides memory.”

SIGNATURE PHYSICAL ELEMENTS

The bottle is the
first touchpoint.

Treating the sculptural cap, heirloom charm, ingredient pouch, and crystal glass as an integrated luxury product design system.

01

Sculptural Cap

“A tactile form inspired by the character of the fragrance.”

Every perfume cap is an original sculptural tribute — from the carved timber grain of Sandalwood and the layered rose petals, to the porcelain jasmine bud, celadon Kasturi petals, and the carved translucent citrus wheel. It turns opening the flacon into a physical tactile discovery.

Custom Tactile Architecture
02

Ingredient Pouch

“A visible material reference that invites curiosity and discovery.”

Suspended beside the bottle neck, a delicate sheer woven pouch presents the raw botanical inspiration — dried rose petals, aromatic sandalwood shavings, or whole jasmine blossoms. It acts as an unadulterated visual anchor to the earth from which the fragrance was conceived.

Sensory Raw Material Reference
03

Keepsake Charm

“A considered detail that gives the bottle its distinctive identity.”

An antique-gold engraved medallion clasped around the flacon's collar. Embossed with the botanical emblem of the fragrance, it serves as an heirloom talisman that endures long after the final spray.

Antique-Gold Talisman
04

The Fragrance & Flacon

“The scent that completes the experience.”

Heavy architectural crystal glass with radiused corners, housing the luminous golden-amber eau de parfum. Designed with balanced proportions to refract ambient light like fine crystal.

Architectural Crystal Flacon

THE IN-PERSON DISCOVERY RITUAL

See → Touch → Smell

“Begin with what you see. Discover what you can touch. Then experience the fragrance for yourself.”

An experiential journey crafted for bespoke boutiques and sensory showcases, where each flacon is accompanied by tactile material references and bespoke discovery rituals.

SEE01 / 03

Visual Discovery

Before a single drop is diffused, your eye takes in the flacon. The crystal clarity of the glass, the organic contours of the sculptural cap, and the warm amber refraction invite contemplation.

Light & Proportion
TOUCH02 / 03

Tactile Connection

Reaching for the bottle, your fingers meet raw texture — sculpted stone petals, carved sandalwood grain, delicate sheer mesh, and the cool weight of the antique-gold talisman.

Material Sensation
SMELL03 / 03

Olfactory Immersion

The ritual culminates as the fine atomizer releases the pure eau de parfum. The visual and tactile expectations unlock their full olfactory reality in harmonic unity.

Harmonic Awakening
